dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: You could say so, but it does also feel like something has changed.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: I mean, I still talk and do things the same way, but I feel a lot more relaxed, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: Take what's happening now, for example. I can say this, and I really mean it — I really envy you for your traveling lifestyle.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: If I had the chance to go to a place where no one cared about the Dendro Archon or King Deshret, I think I would have been a lot freer.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: Yes, thank you for your well wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll get the chance one day.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: Part of me thinks that the misconceptions of our history and belief were built up over so many years that it's become difficult to change... But another part of me wishes for a change to happen.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: ...Heh, let's not dwell on such heavy topics.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: Let me give you some good news. Due to the previous incident, the village head has arranged a night watch at the Village Keepers' dwelling.

dialogues.speaker: Shani
dialogues.text: They have helped Aaru Village, after all. It's only right that the village also does its part to ensure their safety.
